changes.summary: Preserve custom body attributes and standard table behavior on editable scaffold tables.

Scaffold tables gain a money column: MoneyColumn and MoneyCell align amounts to the right with tabular digits, expose the exact decimal in data-value and state a missing currency instead of assuming one. MoneyFromMinor formats minor units with an integer-exact value; MoneyValue renders a figure outside a table.
Insert a newly created user's realtime row only into the Users list instead of every open sfui table, and add TableConfig.BodyAttrs for extra tbody attributes.
